import asyncio, time

    result = asyncio.run(run_batch(size))
    elapsed = time.perf_counter() - started
    print(f'size={size:4d} result={result:4d} elapsed={elapsed:.4f}s serialized_floor={size * WORK_DELAY_SECONDS:.4f}s')
    assert result == size
